name: CaseHardEmptyRegionMinSize
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "hard-empty-region-min-size" (slot). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a CHILDLESS region whose only size facts are min-height / min-width
